fix.summary: Amendments are required before this package may govern work. Replace session-existence birth with correlation-based reconciliation; remove raw/full-command retention and phase-1 excerpts; define producer/write failure semantics without a public format gate; resolve Collector's required --no-session profile; choose the project identity and archive/Doctor topology; and split ADR 0048's two independent decisions. Exact replacement text is recorded in the dispositions below.

classes.name: ADR 0047 fitness
classes.boundary: The zero-LLM caller-stub × envelope-fact architecture, excluding storage topology.
classes.disposition: AMEND. It is short, hard to reverse, and consistent with ADR 0010/0018/0042, but “有存根无 session 即幽灵” is not a truthful birth contract. A Pi session header precedes the package's session_start activation, while a session path/file can exist without successful activation. Replace that clause with: “每次派发先生成 correlation id；共享信封在合法激活完成后写同 id 的最小 activation fact。幽灵由存根缺少匹配 activation fact 的终局对账认定；不以目录或文件单独存在认定出生。” Temporal finality still requires owner choice D1.

classes.name: ADR 0048 fitness
classes.disposition: AMEND/SPLIT. “一家多簿” and “session 正本、账本索引” are two independently hard-to-reverse decisions and should be separate ADRs (or one must be consequence/context, not a second decision). Replace “禁复制、不禁摘录” for phase 1 with “账本只保留关联键、非内容派发事实和正本指针；不复制 session、prompt、task、receipt 或其他内容字节。摘录行为不由第一期授权。” Keep “no validator/second contract factory,” but state that an append failure is infrastructure failure, not malformed-row rejection.

classes.name: Problem evidence
classes.boundary: The four claimed recording holes and DRY demand.
classes.disposition: SOUND WITH ONE CITATION AMENDMENT. #11 Finding 1 supports invocation-profile/skill-binding DRY; README ignition discipline and #49's CDP resurrection prove the pre-session stdin park; #60's corrected exhibit proves stdout duplication caused the false “two rejections” report; #10/#48 prove volatile evidence/retention pain. The exact “245MB” claim was not independently cited in the supplied corpus: attach its retained evidence or delete the number while retaining the supported qualitative claim.

classes.name: User stories 1–7
classes.boundary: Short launch, pre-spawn stub, birth visibility, stdin closure, canonical pointer, preservation, canonical source.
classes.disposition: SOUND IN PURPOSE, AMEND 3/4/6. Story 4 is justified only as behavior naturally owned by the already-justified spawn wrapper; #49 expressly rejected a standalone package guard. Story 3 must say matching envelope fact, not session existence, and cannot promise “当刻” without the owner-selected D1 observation rule. Story 6 cannot be approved until D3 chooses direct-home, move-only archive, or deferral. Stories 1/2/5/7 are sound.

classes.name: User story 8 and full command retention
classes.boundary: What dispatch material may be persisted outside the session.
classes.disposition: STRIKE AS WRITTEN: reconstructing the complete command necessarily retains content-bearing `-p` prompt bytes already present in the session and may retain credentials, directly violating the no-duplication red line and inviting the deleted Recorder's redaction/scanner wall. Exact replacement: “As a record-reader, I want the stub to preserve the non-content invocation shape plus references/digests for content-bearing inputs, so that I can reconstruct provenance without duplicating prompt or session bytes.” Add: “Never persist raw prompt/task bytes, environment, auth headers, or credentials in the ledger; do not add a scanner to make such retention acceptable.”

classes.name: User stories 9–15
classes.owner: Ledger home, package distribution, shared envelope
classes.boundary: Enumerability, project partitioning, consumer footprint, observation substrate, activation fact, ghost state.
classes.disposition: AMEND. Stories 9/10 require an owner-selected stable project identity (D4), including multiple worktrees, remote rename/no remote, and non-Git behavior. Story 11 is sound under #11's first-consumer pull. Story 12 is false while sessions first live under the consumer worktree; align it with D3. Stories 13/14 are sound. Story 15 must distinguish pending from final ghost under D1 rather than label every live no-session process ghost.

classes.name: Canonical launcher profile
classes.owner: Launcher profile registry / caller composition seam
classes.boundary: Which existing Pi role profiles the launcher may construct.
classes.disposition: BLOCKED BY D2. README's required Collector one-shot profile contains `--no-session`, while #78 promises a canonical session pointer and session-based reconciliation for calls and says all callers migrate. The launcher cannot preserve both contracts. The judgment must either exclude Collector/no-session profiles from phase 1 or explicitly amend Collector's public launch contract; this is authority, not Apply detail. For admitted profiles, retaining caller-supplied role/phase/model/thinking/prompt decisions is consistent with ADR 0010.

classes.name: Ledger row and correlation contract
classes.owner: Launcher append seam and minimal ledger reader
classes.boundary: Semantic facts required for two-sided reconciliation, not JSON spelling.
classes.disposition: AMEND. Deferring the correlation key, canonical pointer, project key, and state/time semantics to an implementation-ticket court leaves the public contract ungovernable. Exact minimum wording: “The producer emits one append-only JSONL event per transition with a unique correlation id, project key, observed time, event kind, and only the references/facts required by that kind. There is no published row schema, exact-field rejection, or second validation pass; readers use ordinary JSON parsing and minimally consume required facts per ADR 0043. Failure to append the pre-spawn stub is infrastructure failure and ignition does not proceed.” Concrete field names and serialization mechanics may remain Apply obligations after D1/D4 are settled.

classes.name: Birth and time semantics
classes.boundary: pending/born/ghost finality, process lifetime, deadlines, and caller-owned stopping.
classes.disposition: OWNER DECISION REQUIRED (D1). Session existence is neither sufficient proof of activation nor a temporal terminal rule. A hung child with no matching fact is not safely final unless it exits or a declared observation deadline is crossed. Any timeout/kill/retry policy risks taking caller-owned budget/stopping power under ADR 0010. Whichever option is chosen, launcher must not silently kill or retry; expose `pending`, `born`, and final `ghost`/infrastructure states distinctly.

classes.name: Archive topology and Doctor compatibility
classes.owner: Session-placement/archive seam and Doctor input locator
classes.boundary: Where the sole session bytes live before/after worktree teardown.
classes.disposition: OWNER DECISION REQUIRED (D3). The proposed archive subcommand has not answered the guardrail's simplification question: placing `--session-dir` in the machine home at ignition may delete the archive mechanism entirely. Conversely, current ADR 0017 and `src/doctor-evidence.ts` admit only a retained `.ak/work/issues/<n>/runs` tree, so moving it under a new home while freezing Doctor makes archived evidence unreadable by the current record-reader. If archive is retained, mandate semantic move-only behavior: after success exactly one retained session copy exists; failure leaves the original authoritative and records no success. Do not copy sessions or add redaction/manifest machinery.

classes.name: Testing decisions
classes.owner: Launcher subprocess seam and shared activation-envelope seam
classes.boundary: Observable red/green proof, not helper/function shape.
classes.disposition: AMEND THEN SOUND. The two named seams have real prior art: the package-entrypoint/Pi subprocess harness exposes `timedOut`, and the registry-wide activation-envelope contract exists. Change the normal oracle from “session exists” to “matching activation fact and genuine session header/pointer”; test pending and the D1-selected final ghost rule. Replace speculative “双重派发同名存根” with the owned invariant: “concurrent dispatches receive distinct correlation ids and append complete non-interleaved events.” Keep unwritable-home as the red for honest infrastructure failure. Archive tests depend on D3. Do not assert prose, JSON spelling, internal calls, or introduce a test-only production hook.

classes.name: Out of scope
classes.boundary: Reports, 太史, excerpts, Doctor, #72/#73, Navigator.
classes.disposition: MOSTLY SOUND, ONE CONTRADICTION. Deferring reports/太史/#72/#73/Navigator is honest. Deferring excerpt candles supports striking phase-1 “少量 typed 摘录.” “Doctor redesign frozen” is sound only if D3 preserves Doctor-readable input; otherwise the required locator compatibility change must be brought in explicitly or archive deferred. No statistics claim may be made from phase 1 alone.

classes.name: Red-line audit
classes.boundary: Duplication, format machinery, and Docket Recorder resurrection.
classes.disposition: FAILS AS WRITTEN, CAN BE NARROWED. Raw complete-command retention duplicates prompt content and creates credential pressure. “少量 typed 摘录” pre-authorizes unbounded second content. Worktree-to-home evidence “收进” does not say move versus copy. Those clauses permit the old Recorder shape to regrow. The zero-LLM launcher/index itself is not a Recorder resurrection if narrowed to producer-owned minimal facts, matching pointers, no content copies/excerpts, no scanner/redaction/schema/manifest/receipt extraction, and either direct-home session placement or one-copy move-only preservation.

arguments.note: Overall ruling: amendments first; the package may not govern construction as written. The core direction is supported, but current authority is missing state/time truth, conflicts with Collector's no-session profile, and leaves a real archive-versus-Doctor scope/cost fork. Existing ADR 0019 also means the new envelope fact must replace—not preserve beside—the healthy started/completed lifecycle trace; it may be one consumer-driven invocation fact, not a new stage telemetry contract.

AUTHORITY RULING — amendments first; package may not govern construction as written.

ADR fitness:
• ADR 0047: AMEND. Zero-LLM caller stub × shared-envelope fact is one hard-to-reverse decision, short, and consistent with ADR 0010/0018/0042. But “stub without session = ghost” is false: Pi writes/allocates session state before package session_start activation, so existence does not prove activation. Replace with a pre-spawn correlation id and a matching fact written only after envelope admission; finality is D1.
• ADR 0048: SPLIT/AMEND. Machine-home/project-book topology and session-source/index provenance are independently reversible decisions, unlike single-decision exemplar 0018. Phase 1 wording must be: ledger retains only correlation key, non-content dispatch facts, and canonical pointer; no session/prompt/task/receipt bytes or excerpts. Excerpts remain phase 2. Append failure is infrastructure failure, not format rejection. This respects ADR 0036/0042/0043.

Spec evidence:
• Problem/DRY: SOUND. #11 proves profile/skill-binding DRY; README and #49’s CDP resurrection prove pre-session stdin parking; #60’s corrected exhibit proves stdout duplication caused the false two-rejection report; #10/#48 prove volatile-retention pain. User stories, individually:
1 short launch SOUND. 2 pre-spawn stub SOUND. 3 AMEND to matching activation fact and D1 time rule; “at once” is unsupported without a deadline. 4 SOUND only as behavior of the already-justified spawn wrapper—#49 rejected a separate package guard. 5 canonical pointer SOUND. 6 BLOCKED by D3. 7 SOUND for transcript source, but provenance must be per fact because session lacks dispatch facts. 8 STRIKE/REPLACE: full argv includes `-p` content already in session and may contain credentials, violating no-duplication and recreating Recorder scanner pressure; retain non-content argv shape plus references/digests only. 9 enumerability SOUND after D4. 10 project books BLOCKED by D4. 11 packaged CLI SOUND under #11’s consumer pull. 12 FALSE under worktree-first storage; align with D3. 13 observation substrate SOUND but proves no statistics yet. 14 envelope-authored activation fact SOUND. 15 AMEND: live unmatched is pending; ghost finality is D1.

Implementation decisions:
• Zero-LLM/no role/no Recorder: SOUND only after the narrowing above.
• Home/project shard: BLOCKED by D3/D4.
• Canonical source/index: AMEND to per-fact provenance and no excerpts.
• Dumb append: AMEND exact contract: producer emits append-only JSONL events with unique correlation id, project key, observed time, event kind, and only facts required by that kind; no published row schema, exact-field rejection, or second validation pass; readers minimally parse consumed facts. Failed pre-spawn append aborts honestly. Field spelling remains Apply-local after D1/D4.
• DRY/caller composition: SOUND under ADR 0010, except D2: README’s required Collector profile has `--no-session`, contradicting universal session reconciliation.
• Birth by session existence: STRIKE; use matching envelope fact.
• Envelope self-record: SOUND as one consumer-driven invocation fact replacing—not preserving beside—ADR 0019’s deleted healthy started/completed lifecycle trace.
• Archive: BLOCKED by D3. If retained, semantic move-only: success leaves exactly one retained session copy; failure leaves original authoritative and records no success. This is required by the package’s own no-copy red line, not a new guard.
• npm distribution: SOUND as part of #11, subject to its independent preflight gates.

Testing decisions:
• Observable behavior and the two named seams: SOUND; real subprocess/timedOut and registry activation-envelope prior art exist.
• AMEND normal oracle to matching activation fact plus genuine session header/pointer; cover pending and D1 finality. Replace speculative “same-name duplicate stub” with the actual owned concurrency invariant: distinct correlation ids and complete non-interleaved append events. Keep unwritable home as honest infrastructure red. Archive tests follow D3. No prose/JSON-spelling assertions or test-only production hooks.

Out of scope:
• Reports/statistics, 太史, #72/#73, Navigator: SOUND. Phase-2 excerpt deferral requires deleting phase-1 excerpt authorization. Doctor freeze is contradictory if D3 moves sessions outside ADR 0017/current `src/doctor-evidence.ts`’s required `.ak/work/issues/<n>/runs` locator; either authorize minimal locator compatibility or defer relocation. No phase-1 denominator/statistical claim is allowed.
